Bounded #3565 delivery-extraction review: checked public root exports, the moved decision/parser/sequence, both actual production callers, carried regressions and SQLite decision-at-effect assertions. Executable module body is byte-identical after block comments. Monument owns mode selection, pinned branch parsing, synchronous record-before-effect sequencing and result mapping; Station retains invocation, authorization, key/receipt stores and result consumption. No new command, state or queue. Old server module and unit test were moved, not wrapped. Package remains private 0.1.0; recovery ledger and steer receipt extraction remain open. Evidence uses injected host effects, not a real provider or release.
